verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own docs say you choose a region when creating a machine, and machines come with persistent storage, so users can pick where machine data lives. That region choice appears only as one item in a creation-options list, with no detail on data residency itself. Missing for 10: list of available regions/geographies, explicit data-residency guarantees or commitments, region selection for Notebooks/Deployments/shared drives, independent corroboration.
